title: RationalAmbientPullModels
statement: For a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l, any schemes X,Y and any morphism f:Y $\to$ X, the actual derived continuous-rational module pullback admits a universal counit to ordinary termwise pullback, normalized by the identity-scalar multiplication comparison and invertible on every acyclic-tensor K-flat complex. These are precisely the fields of Pull [def-per-rational-stratum-pullback-data]. No chart, stratum, realization object or cohomological bound is asserted.

source.place: Tag 06YY, lemma-derived-base-change, proof; identity scalar removal uses Modules on Sites Section 03EK.

proof.text:
exact module inverse image is computed termwise and preserves acyclic tensor
K-flat complexes. Compose its derived comparison with the scalar-extension counit.
Remove the identity scalar factor by multiplication, with inverse insertion of one.
Apply the same ordinary comparison termwise. Its section formula is multiplication
on every pure tensor, so the resulting counit has IsNormalizedPullCounit. The
universal property follows by composition of the exact functor with the universal
left derived scalar extension. Exact inverse image preserves K-flatness; hence the
scalar counit, and therefore this counit, is invertible on every K-flat complex.
No condition on the scheme morphism or flatness of its coefficient map is used.
